name: TerraTech-Worlds
description: This Docker will download and install SteamCMD. It will also install TerraTech Worlds and run it. ATTENTION: First Startup can take very long since it downloads the gameserver files! Update Notice: Simply restart the container if a newer version of the game is available. You can also run multiple servers with only one SteamCMD directory!

ports.name: UDP - Game Port
ports.description: UDP Game Port (If you need another port please make sure to delete this entry and create a new UDP port entry with the host and container port set to the same, don't forget to change the port in your config file too).

variables.name: GAME_ID
variables.description: The GAME_ID that the container download at startup. If you want to install a static or beta version of the game change the value to: '2533070 -beta YOURBRANCH' (without quotes, replace YOURBRANCH with the branch or version you want to install).

variables.name: Validate Installation
variables.description: Set the Variable to 'true' if you want to validate the installation otherwise leave it blank.

variables.name: Steam-Username
variables.description: Your Steam username goes here if you want to install a game that needs a valid account, otherwise leave it blank (ATTENTION: You have to disable Steam Guard).

variables.name: Steam-Password
variables.description: Your Steam password goes here if you want to install a game that needs a valid account, otherwise leave it blank (ATTENTION: You have to disable Steam Guard).
